W4.evidence: Fastify supports the `GET`, `HEAD`, `TRACE`, `DELETE`, `OPTIONS`,; `PATCH`, `PUT` and `POST` HTTP methods by default.; The `addHttpMethod` method allows to add any non standard HTTP; methods to the server that are [supported by Node.js](https://nodejs.org/api/http.html#httpmethods).

Y1.evidence: My only desire with this feature was to offload non-standard HTTP methods to user supplied plugins. We should support the baseline RFC 2616 methods
